title: Sequence of Tenses & Tense Harmony
description: Main clause aur subordinate clause ke beech cross-clause tense agreement, General Rule of Past Harmony, earlier/simultaneous/posterior time relationships, aur universal truth exceptions ko master karein.
learningObjectives: Governing main clauses aur dependent subordinate/reported clauses ko identify karna seekhein
General Rule of Past Harmony apply karein: past main verbs subordinate clause mein backshifting demand karte hain
Teeno temporal relationships coordinate karein: Simultaneous (Past Simple/Cont), Earlier (Past Perfect), aur Later (Future-in-the-Past with would/should)
Present aur Future main clauses ke saath subordinate tense ki open flexibility ko samajhein
Universal Truths, Scientific Laws, aur Permanent Facts ke backshift exceptions ko identify aur apply karein
Continuing current facts ko temporary ya historical past states se distinguish karna seekhein

included: Main clause vs subordinate/reported clause ka syntactic relationship
Present aur Future main clauses ke saath tense sequence (Open Sequence Principle)
General Rule of Past Harmony (Simultaneous, Earlier [Past Perfect], Later [would/should])
Universal truths, scientific laws, geographical aur mathematical facts ke rules
Habitual actions, continuing current facts, aur historical facts ka comparison
Clauses of purpose ('so that... may/might') aur comparison ('than/as') mein tense sequence
Competitive exams ke high-frequency backshifting traps aur distractor elimination strategies
excluded: Full Direct/Indirect Narration rules (reporting verb changes, pronoun shift tables, punctuation — Lesson 06 & 07 mein covered hain)
Conditional sentences aur 'if / unless / provided that' clauses (Lesson 03 mein covered hain)
Passive voice transformations (Lesson 04 & 05 mein covered hain)
Subject-Verb concord jo tense harmony se unrelated hai (Lesson 13 mein covered hai)
